Name: CP - Dark Island Cabin and Decor
Author: ENGloomy
Description:
[quote][color=#ffffff][font=Courier New]I don't really have plans for an AT version right now, but feel free to convert it for personal use! Just please don't re-upload it publicly.
If you want to share the AT conversion with the community, just send me a message and I can add it to the mod page as an official update.[/font][/color][/quote][center][color=#ffffff][font=Times New Roman][b][size=3]✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦[/size][/b][/font][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Times New Roman][b]Installation & Usage[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]. (Optional for fountain animation)[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[/list][center][color=#ffffff][b][size=3][font=Times New Roman]Customization[/font][/size][/b][/color][/center]
[font=Arial][size=2][color=#ffffff]Access the [/color][color=#ffd966][b]Mod Options[/b][/color][color=#ffffff] menu under "(CP) Dark Island Cabin and Decor" to toggle specific elements:[/color][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Island Hut & Mailbox[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Island Farm Obelisk[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Island Shipping Bin[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][font=Arial][size=2][color=#ffffff]Island Bush [/color][color=#f1c232](replaces the visual with an invisible texture; hitbox remains)[/color][color=#ffffff].[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][center][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Times New Roman][b]Furniture & Decor[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[left][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=3][size=2]Obtain furniture through:[/size][/size][/font][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=3][size=2]The Furniture Catalogue[/size][/size][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=2]Alternatively, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]﻿Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] (search for "darkisland")[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[center][color=#ffffff][size=4][b][font=Times New Roman]Compatibility[/font][/b][/size][/color][/center]
[left][list]
[*][size=2][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows.[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]SMAPI 4.5.1[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Content Patcher 2.9.0[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0[/font][/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Arial]SpaceCore 1.28.4[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=2]Should be compatible with other recolor mods.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list][/left]
[center][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦[/font][/size][/color][/center]
